cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, decree or policy in force classifies government data or requires it to be held in the country; the move of government servers (MRT-003, MRT-008) does not answer that.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (every lower rung shown by its own evidence): the national government cloud is presented as hosting state services under digital sovereignty (MRT-012, MRT-004, 2026), so stage 2. The minister said all government servers had moved to the ministry's data centre (MRT-008), but no rule on state data is in force, so hosting no longer lifts the cell to 4.
